status.description: complete = every acceptance criterion in the plan is met and verified. partial = some criteria met, rest listed in blockers/follow_ups. blocked = could not make meaningful progress.

summary.description: Two to four sentences describing what was actually implemented. No preamble, no restating the plan.

files_changed.description: Every file created, modified, or deleted. Must be exhaustive.

why.description: One sentence tying this file to a specific acceptance criterion or plan step.

tests_run.description: Every verification command actually executed. Empty array if none were run.

detail.description: Pass/fail counts, or the failure output if it did not pass. Never claim a pass that did not happen.

deviations.description: Anywhere the implementation departs from the plan as written. Empty array if none.

what.description: The plan step or constraint that was not followed literally.

why.description: The reason the departure was necessary.

blockers.description: Things that stopped work: missing context, ambiguous requirements, sandbox or network limits, failing tests that could not be fixed within scope.

follow_ups.description: Deliberately out-of-scope work noticed along the way. Do not implement these; just report them.
